entries.title: Proverbs 18:1
segments: ¶A man who isolates himself seeks his own desire; He rages against all wise judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:2
segments: ¶A fool has no delight in understanding, But in expressing his own heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:3
segments: ¶When the wicked comes, contempt comes also; And with dishonor [comes] reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:4
segments: ¶The words of a man's mouth [are] deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom [is] a flowing brook.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:5
segments: ¶[It is] not good to show partiality to the wicked, [Or] to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:6
segments: ¶A fool's lips enter into contention, And his mouth calls for blows.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:7
segments: A fool's mouth [is] his destruction, And his lips [are] the snare of his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:8
segments: ¶The words of a talebearer [are] like tasty trifles, And they go down into the inmost body.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:9
segments: ¶He who is slothful in his work Is a brother to him who is a great destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:10
segments: ¶The name of the LORD [is] a strong tower; The righteous run to it and are safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:11
segments: ¶The rich man's wealth [is] his strong city, And like a high wall in his own esteem.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:12
segments: ¶Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honor [is] humility.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:13
segments: ¶He who answers a matter before he hears [it], It [is] folly and shame to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:14
segments: ¶The spirit of a man will sustain him in sickness, But who can bear a broken spirit?

entries.title: Proverbs 18:15
segments: ¶The heart of the prudent acquires knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:16
segments: ¶A man's gift makes room for him, And brings him before great men.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:17
segments: ¶The first [one] to plead his cause [seems] right, Until his neighbor comes and examines him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:18
segments: ¶Casting lots causes contentions to cease, And keeps the mighty apart.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:19
segments: ¶A brother offended [is harder to win] than a strong city, And contentions [are] like the bars of a castle.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:20
segments: ¶A man's stomach shall be satisfied from the fruit of his mouth, [From] the produce of his lips he shall be filled.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:21
segments: ¶Death and life [are] in the power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:22
segments: ¶[He who] finds a wife finds a good [thing], And obtains favor from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:23
segments: ¶The poor [man] uses entreaties, But the rich answers roughly.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:24
segments: ¶A man [who has] friends must himself be friendly, But there is a friend [who] sticks closer than a brother.
